title: Integrated open F/O segment replay and extended-state functional JVP

antecedent_evidence.interpretation: The full deep midpoint branch contains a large persistent effect absent from output-head-only adaptation, but the retained traces expose probabilities rather than a realizable decoder-visible mechanism.

claim: Determine whether the exact first-order effect of the full-minus-output midpoint update recovers enough of the observed second-half truth-path gain to justify a compact tangent adapter, and whether that effect is carried primarily by parameter writes or rebuilt recurrent/KV state.
non_claims: JVP ideal bits are arithmetic archive savings.
Teacher parameters or hidden states are eligible submission inputs.
A single-population diagnostic transfers to enwik9.
Exact reconstruction of this segment path completes an open NNCP codec.
The result can be added to any CMIX gain without a fresh joint archive.

population.selection: identical to the retained F/O indexed population

activation_dependencies: nncp_open_top_attention_probability_adjoint_64_q0_v2 passes exact arithmetic and a terminal external resource-guard receipt
no more than two additional isolated backward primitives are admitted after the probability-adjoint gate
all open forward tensors and all 246 midpoint Adam parameter updates remain exact against the bound oracle
candidate source revision and scalar arithmetic contract frozen

primitive_budget.next_required_boundary: this complete first-half forward, loss, backward, update, state rebuild, second-half replay, and JVP experiment
primitive_budget.forbidden: Extending the primitive queue instead of attempting integrated replay.

members: linear-attention or other persistent model state
every mutable value capable of affecting a later probability
extended_state.O_midpoint: z_O is the output-head-only branch immediately after its midpoint update and state rebuild.
extended_state.F_midpoint: z_F is the full-update branch immediately after its midpoint update and state rebuild.
extended_state.delta: delta_z_0 = z_F - z_O using exact bound tensor layouts and materialization.
exclusions: arithmetic coder interval and payload state

first_half: open forward from the exact segment-start state
exact full and output-only backward paths
exact optimizer updates in source order
exact F and O state rebuilds
second_half: open O and F forward probabilities
all ordinary online updates at original call sites
open_replay.parity_requirement: Before JVP interpretation, every open F and O integer branch probability and all probability-capable state hashes must match the retained teacher traces and captured state receipts.
open_replay.failure_class: A parity failure is an implementation or reconstruction failure with no JVP scientific verdict.

tangent_equations.joint_propagation: delta_z_(u+1) = J_f_u(z_O,u) * delta_z_u, including derivatives through every ordinary online update
tangent_equations.parameter_component: T_theta starts with only parameter, optimizer-moment, and optimizer-step coordinates of delta_z_0 nonzero.
tangent_equations.state_component: T_state starts with only recurrent, KV, linear-attention, and rebuilt dynamic-state coordinates of delta_z_0 nonzero.
tangent_equations.joint_component: T_joint starts with the complete delta_z_0 and must equal T_theta plus T_state within the frozen arithmetic tolerance.

arms.T_theta: No-fit tangent initialized from parameter and optimizer coordinates only.
arms.T_state: No-fit tangent initialized from rebuilt recurrent, KV, and persistent dynamic-state coordinates only.
arms.T_joint: No-fit tangent initialized from the complete F-minus-O extended-state delta.
arms.S: T_joint delta_z_0 cyclically reassigned by 257 segments modulo 1024 before second-half propagation.
arms.N: Exact negation of each segment's T_joint initial tangent.

probability_materialization.quantization: Apply the exact bound NNCP integer-probability conversion and clipping used by the retained traces.

measurements.third_recovery_fraction: arm thirdwise truth-path gain divided by F thirdwise truth-path gain
measurements.positive_segment_fraction: fraction of segments with positive arm-versus-O second-half ideal gain
measurements.logit_cosine: cosine between T_joint and F-minus-O branch-logit deltas
measurements.joint_additivity_error: maximum absolute difference between T_joint and T_theta plus T_state logit deltas

reconstruction: open O integer probabilities equal retained O
open F integer probabilities equal retained F
truth, symbol, tree, row, and execution coordinates identical
all extended-state hashes match at preregistered checkpoints

terminal_router.reconstruction_failure: one correction-only open implementation successor; no scientific verdict
terminal_router.joint_pass_theta_dominant: authorize one compact tied-tangent adapter contract
terminal_router.joint_pass_state_dominant: authorize one bounded stateful write-retain adapter contract
terminal_router.state_dominant_definition: T_state truth-path gain is at least 1.25 times T_theta gain and T_state recovery fraction is at least 0.25
terminal_router.joint_recovery_below_half_with_weak_stat: retire compact linear Delta-MIDAS on this parent
terminal_router.open_F_O_pass_but_all_tangents_fail: preserve open parent and pivot to one compact nonlinear student; no further primitive gates

authority.promotion_ceiling: one prospectively frozen compact implementation candidate
